**Round 11: a failed batch save loses the user's typed values (TM-B15, from the verifier's round-8 finding C-R8-01)**
- **The bug:** when a multi-file save fails completely or partly, the form clears what the user typed and disables Save, so they have to retype everything. Single-file saves already keep the input on failure. I reproduced this from round-8 screenshots and an out-of-repo test on `35ed18b`.
